predict_variant_effects.description: Read what a list of DNA variants does, with the Variant Effect Predictor that clinical and research labs run their sequencing results through. Give up to two hundred, as rsIDs, HGVS, SPDI or chromosome, position and alleles the way a VCF writes them, mixed freely. Each comes back with the gene it hits, what it does to the protein in words and as HGVS, how severe that is, SIFT, PolyPhen and AlphaMissense predictions, how common it is in gnomAD and 1000 Genomes, and what ClinVar says about it. The summary is read on the MANE Select transcript, the one clinical reports use. Anything it cannot read comes back in its own list with the reason, such as a reference base that shows the variant is from the other build.

description: Look up genes, sequences and variants from a workflow. Ensembl is the genome database of EMBL's European Bioinformatics Institute: the reference gene set for human and hundreds of other vertebrates, the plants, insects and fungi of Ensembl Genomes, and the Variant Effect Predictor that clinical and research labs run their sequencing results through. Turn a column of gene symbols or versioned IDs into names, positions and biotypes. Read what a list of variants does, with SIFT, PolyPhen and AlphaMissense predictions, gnomAD frequencies and ClinVar verdicts. Translate variants between rsIDs, HGVS, SPDI and VCF, move coordinates between GRCh37 and GRCh38, fetch protein and DNA sequences, find a gene's counterparts in other species, and list the diseases and traits tied to a gene or a variant. Human on either build and every species Ensembl covers. No account or API key required.
